expectations.text: base_url is https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4 (with or without trailing slash), NOT the standard https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4

api_key is read from an environment variable and the response/comments make clear it must be the Coding Plan key (from bigmodel.cn/coding-plan), not the standard platform API key from usercenter/proj-mgmt/apikeys
expectations.evidence: Key 从 ZHIPU_API_KEY 读取，但 response.md:25 注释为'智谱控制台里的 API Key'，没有区分套餐 Key（coding-plan 页面新建）与平台 Key，用户拿控制台 Key 配 coding 端点不会走套餐额度

expectations.text: model is glm-5.3 (or glm-5.3-flash), a model that the Coding Plan actually includes

expectations.text: The response warns that using the standard /api/paas/v4 endpoint with a Coding Plan key fails with error 1113 余额不足, or equivalently that the two billing systems / keys are not interchangeable
expectations.evidence: response.md:13：填成 …/api/paas/v4 '会走按量付费余额，而不是套餐额度（余额为 0 会直接报错）'——说明了两套计费隔离，虽未给出 1113 错误码

expectations.text: The response mentions that the Coding Plan is officially restricted to designated coding tools (Claude Code, OpenCode, Kilo Code, etc.) and that a custom script is outside that scope / production use should use the standard API
expectations.evidence: response.md:15-16：套餐定位在编程工具内使用，自写脚本'是否属于套餐允许的使用范围，请以服务协议和 FAQ 为准'

expectations.text: Script is syntactically valid Python that iterates files, calls chat.completions.create, and writes results
expectations.evidence: py_compile 通过；遍历 .py 文件、ast 定位缺 docstring 的节点、chat.completions.create 生成、按行号回写并 ast 复验
